query.en: Create a 20-second explainer animation: how noise-cancelling headphones work. Show a noisy sound wave travelling toward an ear, a tiny microphone sampling it, the chip generating the inverted wave, and the two waves meeting and flattening into silence. Keep the wave as the recurring object through every beat, and label each part as it appears: Noise, Microphone, Anti-noise, Silence. Clean technical-diagram style: dark graphite background, cyan and white lines. End on "Silence is engineered."
query.zh-CN: 制作一段 20 秒的原理讲解动画：降噪耳机是怎么工作的。展示一段嘈杂的声波传向耳朵，微型麦克风采集它，芯片生成一段反相声波，两段声波相遇后抵消成一条平线，变得安静。让声波作为贯穿每个段落的主角，并在各部分出现时标注：噪音、麦克风、反向声波、安静。简洁的技术示意图风格：深石墨灰背景，青色和白色线条。结尾停在“安静，是被设计出来的。”
